critical_changes: Narrow and correct the headline claim. Replace 'for related painters' with the tested scope (four related painters, one template, 14 scenes), state the geometric condition under which a faithful imitator's change is mostly shared (N* >> H), and qualify 'would remain true for a generator that reproduced each painter exactly', because the CSD faithful share is 48.3% for GPT Image 2 and the observed share is 54.2% (Abstract, Intro bullet 2, Sec. 5.2, Recommendations).

Make the faithful benchmark interpretable. Report a benchmark that holds the observed shared movement fixed, e.g. N/(N+H) (recomputed: 84.0, 83.3, 83.3, 79.9, 57.6, 84.2%), or decompose the observed-vs-faithful gap into coverage (lambda, N/N*) and between-name size (B/H). State that 'below faithful' does not mean 'more specific' (Nano Banana 2 is below faithful only because lambda = 24.8%). Revise the Figure 3 caption and the abstract (Sec. 5.1).

Support or narrow the pair- and representation-level claims. Add scene and reference-resampling intervals for pair beta and pair D (Fig. 4; Monet-Sisley columns of Table 14, all representations). Report the 31-feature discriminability of genuine works next to the 79.8/79.6% embedding check (recomputed: about 50% macro on the development panel, Monet 40%, Sisley 31%). Qualify 'unevenly across painter pairs and representations' and 'does not transfer to the embeddings' (Sec. 5.3, Abstract).

Correct the texture claim. In Table 6, texture is least shared in only 3 of 6 main configurations (GPT Image 1, Flare, FLUX.2 Max) plus SD-Turbo, and it is the most shared family for Nano Banana 2. Rephrase Intro bullet 5, the Sec. 5.5 title and the abstract clause.
minor_changes: Show the genuine-painting D distribution next to Table 3 (pooled 0.234; class vs pooled target 0.753; class vs class target 0.731, which is in the outputs but not the paper). Explain that these controls include half-sample target noise, and tone down the 'no-distinction' (D = 1) framing in the Intro and Sec. 5.3.

Hedge the first sentence of Sec. 6 ('movement toward the four painters' common appearance'), because t also carries reproduction and old-painting properties. Name a fictitious-name, group-clause or distant-painter control as the test.

Positioning: name concrete published uses of prototype-proximity readouts (CSD GSS; Su et al. prototype similarity); note that closed-set recognition already uses between-name information; add change-direction readouts (CLIP directional similarity, Gal et al. 2022 / InstructPix2Pix); mention Su et al.'s observation of weak artist-name effects in recent generators; consider Xing et al. 2026 (arXiv:2608.06751).

Disclose the terminated first collection (an upstream route returned an image for an invalid model ID) and the 16-to-14 scene reduction made before outcomes. Distinguish the prespecified paired-scene bootstrap for pairwise D from the post-hoc readout bootstrap of Table 5 (Sec. 4.5 currently lists 'the scene bootstrap' as post hoc).
Add scene-deletion ranges to Table 2 (they exist in the outputs, e.g. CSD GPT Image 2: 52.4-55.6%).
Flag in Sec. 5.1 or the abstract that the shared fraction depends on aggregation (52.8-93.6% within scenes; 82.5-95.7% against the artist-free baseline).
Add a figure for the title claim: stacked shared vs painter-specific proximity gain, observed vs faithful, per configuration and encoder.
Readability: move a compact notation table into the main text, reduce the number of numeric ranges in the abstract, and rewrite dense sentences (e.g. the end of Sec. 5.1 paragraph 3).
De-emphasise the exchangeable-null comparison; given the faithful benchmark it carries little information.
Add content matching of the reference target to the Recommendations (Table 15 shows D shifting by up to 0.2).
Release the generated images through an external archive at camera-ready.
factual_errors: Intro bullet 5 / Sec. 5.5 title / Abstract: 'Texture is the least shared feature family' is contradicted per configuration by Table 6. Spatial is lower for GPT Image 2 (59.6 vs 73.8) and Sunburst (61.5 vs 70.3); for Nano Banana 2 texture (79.8) is the most shared family.
Abstract sentence 2: proximity gain 'would remain true' (mostly shared) for a faithful imitator is contradicted by the CSD faithful value of 48.3% for GPT Image 2 (Table 2).
